Class ThinkStrip

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
org.aetheris.swing.ThinkStrip
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public final class ThinkStrip extends JPanel
The ThinkStrip class is the thinking pane. One instance slides up from the bottom on the notebook. That instance puts the grip on the north edge. Another instance slides down from the top on a VT100 panel. That instance puts the grip on the south edge. The strip paints, folds, and slides. The ThinkStrip.Host decides which thought arrives. The ThinkStrip.Host also decides whether the log is written. The strip does not read a frame, a cell, or a channel.

  • Constructor Details

    • ThinkStrip

      public ThinkStrip(SshClientTheme theme, Font bodyFont, int chromeSize, boolean keepsLog, int userHeight, boolean closed, boolean alongTop, ThinkStrip.Host host)
      The constructor builds a hidden strip. A chrome size below 8 is stored as 8. The closed flag is stored as given. The pane is not editable. The pane background is 0x1a1a1a. The caret color is 0x00D7FF. A null body font sizes the scroll pane from the current face, or from a 12-point monospaced face. That scroll height is three line heights plus 8. The natural height is the preferred height while the user height is temporarily 0. A natural height below 48 becomes 48. The strip starts invisible. keepsLog true says the log stays between sessions and is not stored on the turn. keepsLog false says the text is not written to the vault log. alongTop true puts the grip on the south edge with a south-resize cursor. alongTop false puts the grip on the north edge with a north-resize cursor.
      Parameters:
      theme - The theme is the dark painter.
      bodyFont - The body font is the monospaced body, or null.
      chromeSize - The chrome size is the point size for the buttons.
      keepsLog - The flag is true when the vault log is written and the tips say so.
      userHeight - The user height is the dragged height, or 0.
      closed - The flag is true when a closed pane stays hidden until a thought opens it.
      alongTop - The flag is true when the grip sits on the south edge and the pane grows downward.
      host - The host owns the log and the chrome.

  • Method Details

    • naturalHeight

      public int naturalHeight()
      The naturalHeight method returns the stored three-line height. The constructor stores at least 48.
      Returns:
      The return value is that height.

    • loadStoredLog

      public void loadStoredLog()
      The loadStoredLog method reads the host log into the pane. A strip that does not keep a log stays hidden. A null host stays hidden. A null or empty log stays hidden. The text is inserted at the start with bodyAttrs(). restyleTags() then paints lines that begin with the box-drawing character. A BadLocationException hides the pane. A closed pane stays hidden. Any other stored log sets the session open and shows the pane.

    • begin

      public void begin(String tag, String text)
      The begin method opens a block with the tag and the first chunk. A null pane returns without writing. pinTail() runs before the insert. A blank tag becomes the word model. The tag line is two box-drawing characters, the word, and two more. A pane that already has text gets a blank line first. A non-empty chunk is written in the body face. A BadLocationException returns without opening the tail. showTail() opens the pane.
      Parameters:
      tag - The tag is the model word.
      text - The text is the first chunk.

    • append

      public void append(String text)
      The append method writes a later chunk of the open block. A null pane returns without writing. A null or empty chunk returns without writing. pinTail() runs before the insert. A BadLocationException returns without opening the tail. showTail() opens the pane.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the chunk.

    • text

      String text()
      The text method returns the pane text. A null pane returns an empty string. A BadLocationException returns an empty string.
      Returns:
      the text now in the pane

    • showLog

      void showLog(String text)
      The showLog method replaces the pane text with one stored log. The method does not write the log back. An empty log hides the strip. A closed strip stays hidden. A log with text opens the strip unless it is closed, and the fold stays folded. restyleTags() paints the banner lines.
      Parameters:
      text - the stored log, or empty

    • finish

      public void finish()
      The finish method marks the open block closed by doing nothing. The method body is empty. The pane stays up. Close is the dismiss.

    • setBodyFont

      public void setBodyFont(Font font)
      The setBodyFont method gives the output this face. A null font returns without a change. A null pane returns without a change. Text already in the pane takes the family and the size. The three-line scroll height follows the new size. The scroll width stays the current preferred width when that width is above 0. Otherwise the scroll width is 240.
      Parameters:
      font - The font is the monospaced body at the app size.

    • setChromeSize

      public void setChromeSize(int size)
      The setChromeSize method fits the buttons at one point size. A size below 8 is stored as 8. The toggle and Close are fitted. The clear button is painted at the same size.
      Parameters:
      size - The size is the point size.

    • getPreferredSize

      public Dimension getPreferredSize()
      The getPreferredSize method returns the height the strip is using. A slide height at or above 0 wins. An open strip with a user height above 0 uses that height. That height is capped by ceiling(). That height is also raised to naturalHeight when it is shorter. Every other case returns the superclass size.
      Overrides:
      getPreferredSize in class JComponent
      Returns:
      The return value is that size.

    • pinTail

      private void pinTail()
      The pinTail method moves the viewport to the last line already in the buffer. A null scroll pane returns without moving. begin(String, String) and append(String) call this before the new block. showTail() calls it after the insert. The scrollbar is set to its maximum now. A later runnable sets that maximum again after validation.

    • showTail

      private void showTail()
      The showTail method marks the session open and shows the tail. pinTail() runs again. persistLog() writes the pane when this strip keeps a log. A folded strip becomes visible and stays folded. An open strip calls openStrip(). A host lays the surface out again.

    • fold

      private void fold()
      The fold method toggles the folded row. A running slide timer is stopped. The slide height is cleared. A folded toggle reads ^. An open toggle reads v. The scroll pane is hidden while folded. seatFoldedRow() moves the buttons. A host lays the surface out again.

    • seatFoldedRow

      private void seatFoldedRow()
      The seatFoldedRow method places one folded row. A folded strip hides the text row. The mark, the drag line, C, and Close sit on the grip. An open strip puts the mark and Close back on the text row. C stays on the grip.

    • detach

      private static void detach(Component child)
      The detach method removes a child from its parent. A null child returns without a change. A child with no parent returns without a change.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is the component to detach.

    • pressGrip

      private void pressGrip(MouseEvent e)
      The pressGrip method records the drag start. A button other than button 1 returns without a change. A running slide timer is stopped. A folded strip records the user height, or the natural height when the user height is 0. An open strip records the current height, raised to the natural height when it is shorter.
      Parameters:
      e - The event is the mouse press.

    • releaseGrip

      private void releaseGrip(MouseEvent e)
      The releaseGrip method ends a drag. A button other than button 1 returns without a change. The slide height is cleared. note() remembers the chrome. A host writes that chrome. A host lays the surface out again.
      Parameters:
      e - The event is the mouse release.

    • dragGrip

      private void dragGrip(MouseEvent e)
      The dragGrip method sets the height from the pointer. A top strip grows when the pointer moves down. A bottom strip grows when the pointer moves up. The height stays at least the natural height. The height stays at most ceiling(). A folded strip stores the height and does not slide. An open strip uses the height as the slide height and lays the host out again.
      Parameters:
      e - The event is the drag.

    • clearLog

      private void clearLog()
      The clearLog method wipes the pane. A BadLocationException is ignored. The next thought still appends. persistLog() writes the empty pane when this strip keeps a log. A host drops its open block. The session stays open. The scroll pane stays hidden while the strip is folded.

    • revealFromMenu

      public void revealFromMenu()
      The revealFromMenu method answers Tools, Show Thinking. ToolsThinking.show(boolean, int) receives the session-open flag and the slide height. A closed pane rises. A fold opens so the text is visible. A pane that is already showing stays at its height. The log stays. The closed mark on the file stays. A pane that was closed stops a running timer and slides open. The slide target is the user height, or the natural height, and at least 1. The target is capped by ceiling().

    • openStrip

      private void openStrip()
      The openStrip method shows an open strip. The session is marked open. A folded strip returns without sliding. A visible strip with a height above 0 and no slide returns without sliding. A slide that is already opening returns without starting another. A closed mark is cleared, remembered, and written. A strip that was hidden starts the slide at height 0. The target is the user height, or the natural height, and at least 1. The target is capped by ceiling().

    • hideStrip

      private void hideStrip()
      The hideStrip method closes the pane. The session is marked closed. A strip that is already hidden returns without writing. The closed mark is set, remembered, and written. A missing slide height starts from the current height. The slide target is 0.

    • slide

      private void slide(int target, boolean rising)
      The slide method moves the height toward a target. An existing timer is stopped. A missing slide height starts from the current height. The timer ticks every 16 milliseconds. Each step is at least 12 pixels, or one quarter of the remaining span. A rising slide stops at the target. A falling slide stops at the target, hides the strip, and restores the open row. A host lays the surface out again on each tick and when the slide ends.
      Parameters:
      target - The target is the height in pixels.
      rising - The flag is true when the pane is growing.

    • ceiling

      private int ceiling()
      The ceiling method returns the tallest allowed height. A null host returns 480. A host height below the natural height returns the natural height.
      Returns:
      The return value is that height.

    • note

      private void note()
      The note method asks the host to remember the chrome. A null host returns without a call. The height passed is the user height. A user height of 0 means the three-line height.

    • persistLog

      private void persistLog()
      The persistLog method writes the pane text when this strip keeps a log. A strip that does not keep a log returns without writing. A null host returns without writing. A BadLocationException returns without writing.

    • restyleTags

      private void restyleTags()
      The restyleTags method paints each tag line in the tag face. A line that begins with the box-drawing character takes tagAttrs(). The newline is not part of that run. A BadLocationException returns and leaves the rest of the pane alone.

    • tagWord

      private static String tagWord(String model)
      The tagWord method turns a model id into the tag word. A null id is empty. A newline is dropped. A carriage return is dropped. A box-drawing character is dropped. A blank result returns model. A word longer than 80 characters keeps the first 80.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id.
      Returns:
      The return value is that word.

      private SimpleAttributeSet tagAttrs()
      The tagAttrs method builds the tag face. The foreground is the cyan 0x00D7FF. The run is bold. seatFace(SimpleAttributeSet) adds the body family and size.
      Returns:
      The return value is that attribute set.

    • bodyColor

      static Color bodyColor(boolean alongTop)
      The bodyColor method returns the thinking body color. The notebook strip and the VT100 strip wear the lighter sapphire. alongTop does not change the color. Both branches return VT_THINK_BODY.
      Parameters:
      alongTop - The flag is true when the strip sits on a VT100 panel.
      Returns:
      The return value is VT_THINK_BODY.

    • seatFace

      private void seatFace(SimpleAttributeSet attrs)
      The seatFace method puts the live body face on one run. The font is bodyFont when it is set. Otherwise the font is the pane font. A missing font returns without a change. Color already on the run stays. Weight already on the run stays.
      Parameters:
      attrs - The attributes are the run being written.

      static Color lightenTowardWhite(Color color, int percent)
      The lightenTowardWhite method mixes a percent of the way from a color toward white. Each channel is lightenChannel(int, int). Each channel rounds half up.
      Parameters:
      color - The color is the source.
      percent - The percent is 0 through 100.
      Returns:
      The return value is the lighter color.

    • lightenChannel

      private static int lightenChannel(int value, int percent)
      The lightenChannel method moves one channel toward 255. The added amount is the remaining distance times the percent, plus 50, divided by 100. A result above 255 returns 255.
      Parameters:
      value - The value is the channel from 0 through 255.
      percent - The percent is the mix toward white.
      Returns:
      The return value is the lighter channel.

      The return value is that attribute set.

    • fitButton

      private void fitButton(AbstractButton button)
      The fitButton method shortens one chrome button. A null button returns without a change. The client property aetheris.short is set to true. The target height is 70 percent of the preferred height, and at least 1. The font shrinks while it is above 8 and the preferred height is still above that target. holdShortLabel(AbstractButton) then keeps the word readable.
      Parameters:
      button - The button is a chrome button.

    • holdShortLabel

      private static void holdShortLabel(AbstractButton button)
      The holdShortLabel method keeps a short label wide enough for its word. The short fit can lock a width under the word. The short fit can lock a height under the word. A label of one or two characters takes two ems after the border is on. A label already under its word takes those two ems as well. The height stays the short fit when the word fits. The height rises when the short fit is under the word. The button text stays the specified text. A null button returns without a change. A width below 1 becomes 1. A height below 1 becomes 1.
      Parameters:
      button - The button is a short chrome button.

    • paintRustClear

      static void paintRustClear(AbstractButton button, int pointSize)
      The paintRustClear method paints C on the canvas strip and on the VT100 strip. The client property aetheris.mark is set to true. The client property aetheris.rust is set to true. AetherisNotebookPanel.seatRustLetter(AbstractButton, int) paints the letter. The fill is sapphire. The letter is white. The stroke is one white pixel. The corner radius is 2. The box follows the Rust pin face at pointSize. The box is at least 22 by 22. The background is then SELECTION_SAPPHIRE. The foreground is then white.
      Parameters:
      button - The button is the clear mark.
      pointSize - The point size is the app point size.

      Parameters:
      button - The button is the clear mark.
